description: Date range and squareoff timing for the portfolio.

fields.label: Start Date
fields.description: First date for backtest data range. Overrides per-leg dates.

fields.label: End Date
fields.description: Last date for backtest data range. Overrides per-leg dates.

fields.label: SqOff Time
fields.description: Force-exit all open positions at this time. Used by backtest engine.

fields.label: Window spans to next day (overnight)
fields.description: Allow the entry window / square-off to cross midnight (NRML / 24h sessions). When off, a window whose End or SqOff decreases past midnight is rejected on save. Disabled for MIS.
